updates.assessment: Options stages a new namespace with the exact Enter the namespace. prompt, lower/strip/trailing-colon and shared garbage cleanup, exact reserved/default and duplicate warnings, and fresh random RGB. Cancel changes neither list nor saved settings; accepted Add changes only the parent draft until Apply. Saved/reopened colours drive real media tag rows. Pending child blocks Apply, hidden owner rejects acceptance, parent Cancel retires callbacks, and retained old Cancel cannot clear a successor slot. Initial strip includes Python control-character whitespace U+001C–U+001F. Sorted Add preserves selected namespace identities while retaining numeric last-hit, Shift anchor, and range bookkeeping, as recorded for Shift/Ctrl+Shift contraction. Nested colon namespaces retain the literal namespace plus trailing-colon label (artist:inner:) and sort by that painted text. Invalid handler input closes Enter Text then opens an owned Warning notice with the exact message and sole OK button; acknowledgement releases the child slot, parent Apply is blocked, parent Cancel retires it, and stale question/notice callbacks cannot mutate or clear a successor. Actual empty Apply/Return is rejected before the handler: a nested Warning says Cannot enter blank text here!, acknowledgement retains the same visible entry, and parent cancellation retires both. Whitespace still reaches the handler.

updates.assessment: Ctrl/Shift selected ordinary namespaces offer exactly Delete all selected colours?; No preserves the list and settings, Yes removes selected ordinary entries while preserving default namespaced and unnamespaced colours even within mixed selection. Protected-only selection offers no deletion question. All changes remain in the Options parent draft; parent Cancel discards, Apply persists and fresh reopen restores the mapping. Current tag-list colours consume saved mappings. Delete remains enabled for empty/protected selections, which do not open a question or change the draft; accepted deletion resets range bookkeeping. The native confirmation uses the reference Are you sure? title and yes/no mode.
